enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Dexterity +9: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Intelligence +4: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +4 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Disable Device +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.
Open Lock +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Open Lock skill.

Greater Nimbleness: This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 2 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.
